results.checks: On a desktop the bar is ‹ Books · Search · Discover · the extensions · More ›, each with its word under the icon; Books opens the book picker and Search opens Your content with its search box ready; More lists Sign in, Live session, Today, Notes, Library, Your content, Full screen and Themes. On a phone every one of those actions is in the top bar or its More

results.title: Settings in the sidebar
results.checks: The ⚙ at the bottom left of the sidebar turns the sidebar into Settings, in place of the tabs — Account settings, Display & Theme, Toolbar, Extensions, Install App, Launch tutorial, Customize, About Seed Bible, then Language; Display & Theme opens its page there, a line-height choice there changes the chapter, ← goes back to the list; ✕ brings the tabs back
